verdict.rationale: Jitsu's evidence describes a Profile Builder that generates customer profiles from `identify` event traits using JavaScript functions (jitsu-docs-11, jitsu-docs-12, jitsu-docs-28), and even shows a raw SQL query as the way to filter/segment events (jitsu-docs-43) — the opposite of a no-SQL visual audience builder. There is no mention of a drag-and-drop audience builder, trait/behavior segment UI, or an estimated-audience-size preview before activation anywhere in the pack.
